gen-gf-autour-one-gf-alumni-sans-pinstri: Big, bold roundness: Autour One barely steps down from capitals to lowercase. Alumni Sans Pinstripe follows with tightly packed sans text whose oversized lowercase towers over its small capitals.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Rounded and loud, Autour One leads with wire-bent sign energy. Page after page, Alumni Sans SC settles into a tightly packed column, its stems just slightly heavier than the hairlines.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-krona-one: Autour One's strokes hold steady, like drawn cable, round and bold. Krona One spaces its sans letters loosely and gives the lowercase the stature of cast iron capitals, which is the real draw.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-major-mono-display: Expressive from the first glyph, Autour One gives each round letter a clear channel and barely any cap-to-lowercase step. Major Mono Display's neon-tube strokes and sidebearings give the heading room to breathe.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-rambla: Ring-round and loud, Autour One keeps its walls constant and barely drops in size from capitals to lowercase. Rambla's near-capital lowercase keeps longer text feeling clean and steady throughout.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-saira-semi-condense: Autour One is all round, bold shapes with little step to lowercase. Saira Semi Condensed's best trick is plain sans text that looks magnified while holding one unvarying weight word to word.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-secular-one: Big round shapes with hardly any step down: that's Autour One. It earns its keep on big, short lines, while Secular One's dominant midsection and unmodulated strokes keep the plain sans text modern.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans packs its line tight, with a high midline. Autour One's bold, ballpoint-plain strokes give the heading weight, and that sets off the closely packed text beneath it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sofia-sans-condense: Round, loud and level: Autour One barely steps down to lowercase. Sofia Sans Condensed adds pen-lifted curves left open and a big x-height, so the body keeps pace without calligraphic fuss.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-tiny5: Bent-tubing roundness, all one gauge: that's Autour One, bold and expressive. Tiny5 does its best work as tall, sans-serif text with short-looking ascenders, while Autour One saves its volume for headings.
